title: feat(resilient-offer-mapping): skip unmappable offers instead of failing a source

req_statements.R1: WHEN `JobConnector.map_offer` raises `ValueError` for one payload during `sync_source`, the system shall skip that payload and continue mapping the remaining payloads.
req_statements.R2: WHEN `sync_source` finishes, the system shall persist exactly one `JobOffer` per successfully mapped payload through `upsert_job_offer`.
req_statements.R3: The system shall not mark a source as failed when its only mapping failures are per-payload `ValueError` exceptions.
req_statements.R4: The system shall expose the number of payloads skipped by per-payload `ValueError` in `SyncResult` through a `skipped` field.
req_statements.R5: The system shall expose the number of payloads skipped by per-payload `ValueError` in one attempted source through a `SourceRun.skipped` field.
req_statements.R6: The system shall expose the total number of payloads skipped across a collection run through a `CollectionResult.skipped` property.
req_statements.R7: WHEN `sync_source` returns without raising for a source, the system shall set the source status to `active`, including when every payload was skipped.
req_statements.R8: WHEN the `api_url` derivation of a connector raises `ValueError`, the system shall propagate the `ValueError` out of `sync_source`.
req_statements.R9: WHEN the validation of a `GenericApiConfig` or a `GenericHtmlConfig` raises `ValueError`, the system shall propagate the `ValueError` out of `sync_source`.
req_statements.R10: WHEN `JobConnector.parse` raises `ValueError`, the system shall propagate the `ValueError` out of `sync_source`.
req_statements.R11: WHEN the transport raises `ConnectorError`, the system shall propagate the `ConnectorError` out of `sync_source`.
req_statements.R12: WHEN `sync_source` raises `ValueError` or `ConnectorError`, the system shall set the source status to `error`.
req_statements.R13: WHEN `sync_source` raises `ValueError` or `ConnectorError`, the system shall roll back every uncommitted `JobOffer` change of that source.
req_statements.R14: WHEN `sync_source` skips at least one payload, the system shall log one warning that names the source and reports the skipped count, using `%s` placeholders.
